coordinates.locator: OpenStreetMap way 821080729 'Williams Field' (aerodrome NZWD), tags gns:DMS_LAT and gns:DMS_LONG
coordinates.note: This point is Williams Field (the launch strip named on ANITA's own campaign pages for the ANITA-II flight; NASA's balloon-facility page says 'LDB Camp, McMurdo Station'). The numbers are the gns:DMS_LAT / gns:DMS_LONG tags (77°52'03"S 167°03'24"E, apparently copied from the GEOnet Names Server; not checked there) of the OpenStreetMap aerodrome object for Williams Field; the point lies inside that object's mapped outline, about 0.7 km from its centroid. The exact launch pad varied by flight/year (LDB Camp vs Williams Field, both near McMurdo Station), so it marks the launch area only (precision 20 km) and is not a precise position. ANITA does not detect at this location anyway.

summary.plain: The icy airstrip near McMurdo Station, Antarctica, where giant NASA balloons carrying instruments like ANITA are launched.
summary.technical: NASA long-duration-balloon launch site (LDB Camp / Williams Field) near McMurdo Station, Antarctica, used for the ANITA balloon flights; a launch point, not a detection location.
